messages:
maria (support): Customer reports intermittent 504s for hosted streaming generate in eu-west-1. Customer: AcmeHealth. Started ~2026-03-16 09:10 UTC. They see 'upstream timeout' and repeated SDK retries. Correlation id: 7f1a2b. Sample repro below.

maria (support): ```bash
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-xl","stream":true,"prompt":"test"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate/stream
```

maria (support): Customer notes non-streaming calls usually succeed; streaming fails ~1/10 calls after ~15s. Using python SDK v1.4.2, keepalive=30s.

cheng (sre): Thanks — can you paste the full x-request-id header values and the SDK traceback if any? Also confirm region (eu-west-1). We'll check gateway and egress queues.

maria (support): x-request-id: 7f1a2b-0001. SDK: python 1.4.2. Customer sent a small capture showing chunked frames then `504 Gateway Timeout` from our edge. Repro steps: run the curl above with `--no-buffer` and watch for the 504.

ashley (eng-infra): Sounds like keepalive mismatch / upstream read timeout may be involved. Quick ask: can we get tcpdump from the edge for one occurrence? For mitigation: suggest customer fall back to non-streaming or route to us-west-2, and recommend SDK backoff + connection reuse.

cheng (sre): Pulled gateway logs for 7f1a2b-0001 — shows `upstream read timeout` then an internal proxy 502. Queue depth spiked at the same timeframe (09:08-09:12 UTC). Tagging @sre-oncall for capacity/pgpu check.

sre-oncall: Oncall here. I see autoscaler hit concurrency ceiling in eu-west-1 for a short window, scheduling lag ~4m. Opening a brief capacity incident to investigate. Temporary mitigation: advise customer to reduce client `max_in_flight` to 4 and enable region fallback. I'll escalate if errors continue.

maria (support): Drafting customer update: "We're investigating intermittent errors affecting streaming in EU. Temporary workarounds: use non-streaming or route to US region. Our infra team is rolling a canary fix to edge keepalive and upstream timeouts. Will update in ~1h." :thumbsup:

cheng (sre): Correlating traces — noticing TLS session rekeying churn at the edge for long-lived streaming connections (sessions re-negotiated ~every 10s). That can surface as upstream read timeouts when combined with scheduling spikes. Plan: bump upstream keepalive and read timeout to 45s and adjust nginx proxy settings. Starting a canary deploy to eu-west-1.

deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/edge-keepalive-bump canary -> eu-west-1 (deploy id: d-90234)

ashley (eng-infra): Also adding `X-Redwood-Duration` header to gateway logs so support/customer can more easily correlate client vs. server time. Will include in canary.

cheng (sre): Canary metrics: 20m running, no 504s for previously failing traces. Rolling to 50% in 10m and monitoring p95. If stable, we'll roll fully.

maria (support): Customer update sent: "Thanks — routing to US and the canary change reduced failures. We'll notify when the rollout completes and follow up with a postmortem if needed."

sre-oncall: Marking this thread monitored. Filed INF-4523 for follow-up tuning and telemetry. Will reopen channel if we see recurrence.
